newsitem.title: UK: UK's Knight says recovery in control, sales healthy.
newsitem.headline: UK's Knight says recovery in control, sales healthy.

text.p: The British Treasury's economic secretary, Angela Knight, said on Wednesday that British retail sales are on a healthy upward path while the country's recovery remains in control.

"The in-control recovery continues. High street sales remain on a healthy upward path with January sales providing an all-round welcome winter warmer for the British economy," Knight said in a statement read by a British Treasury official.
British retail sales rose 0.6 percent in January and were up 4.6 percent in the year in volume terms, the Office for National Statistics said on Wednesday.
